name_note: No abstract naming Ruminococcoides intestinihominis was retrieved, so the sentences below describe the genus Ruminococcoides and its type species Ruminococcoides bili, not this species specifically.

sentences.text: The genus Ruminococcoides was proposed within the family Ruminococcaceae for the type species Ruminococcoides bili, based on a strain isolated from human bile.
Ruminococcoides has been described as a genus abundant in the human colon that plays a key role in carbohydrate metabolism.
Ruminococcoides bili has also been isolated from human faeces, and a study identified in it a glucosidase with the potential to degrade prebiotic substrates.
An exploratory analysis of children reported Ruminococcoides among the genera more proportionally abundant among non-stunted children.
